pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregularly polygonal dark regions with sharp pixel-level edge gradients and non-linear boundaries. Spatial area is greatest on the mid-neck, becoming smaller and more clustered near the shoulder.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-toned interstitial pathways with well-defined junction nodes connecting 3-4 patches. Pixel thickness of the pathways is relatively constant across the visible flank and neck regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette along the upper neck, corresponding to the mane profile against the background.
